notes.title: A collection of popular questions - Wartile Q&A
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12134150/cc01d80c5ba3b9b0275506215ca9f448bc30254a.jpg[/img]

Since launching Wartile we have closely been following the Steam forums closely and the feedback that you all have written to us through the Google questionnaire. 

We have made a small Q&A, to give you all a better understanding of our plans for the future and share how how we plan to address some of the problems and desires that you generally have. 

[b]Q: For how long do you plan Wartile to be in Early Access?[/b]

A: Our production plans says 5-6 months, so if everything goes as planned that should be it. But the reality of game development is that its really hard to predict as most games becomes a beast of its own, and some features may take longer than planned. 

[b]Q: What additional content are you planning on adding to the game?[/b]

A: We already have three new and unique environmental themes in production. From these we expect to create more than 5 new challenging battle boards both for multiplayer and singleplayer. Apart from that we expect to introduce three new Viking classes, each in different versions coming from different tribes, with their own stat build and unique selection of ability cards. 

With every major update we will also increase the amount of godly and tactical cards significantly in order to provide the players with a true feeling of diversity when assembling their deck.

A wide selection of equipment is also on the drawing board and will be introduced every time we bring a new Viking tribe or battle board update.

With the Early Access release, we have been focused on stability and a strong foundation in the game mechanics, that we can build upon. The past week we have focused on fixing various bugs reported by our community and soon we will be able to commit all our time new content, and required improvements. 

[b]Next planned content update - 0.4.5.0[/b]

New battle board challenge - The Rescue
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12134150/ffa845d2ca94b9cc120fd5ef08e79f1d5088c109.jpg[/img]
[i]You arrive under the darkness of night, silently moving like shadows to learn that the island is occupied by a large English garrison. Luckily everyone is sleeping, even the guards supposed to be on watch.
[/i]

[b]Next planned Adventure pack update - 0.5.0.0[/b]

[list]
[*]Introducing a new battle board environment theme.
[*]Adding at least one new Viking character class, with a set of unique abilities.
[*]A new selection of unlockable godly and tactical cards.
[*]New equipment sets, and much more.
[/list]
[i]We keep the details a secret for now :)[/i]

[b]Q:Will there be monsters and mysterious creatures in the game.[/b]

A: Yes, the universe of Wartile is a fantasy universe inspired by history, mythology and lore. It contains beasts and creatures yet to be added with our upcoming updates. So arm yourselves!

[b]Q: I would love to go on a viking raid to plunder and pillage with a friend, will you introduce Co-op play?[/b]

A: We see a growing interest in having the possibility to play Co-op and will investigate different options into how we can support this. 

[b]Q: I would like more time to think about my strategic approaches in the game, will you add a pause button or a system to play the game at a slower phase?[/b]

A: Pressing Spacebar will slow down the game significantly, giving you a small moment to breath and allow you to move a unit or play a card.

[b]Q: I would like more information about each figurine and what their strengths are. I would also like it to know what the different items do and if they are possible upgrades to my vikings equipment, will there be added more information on stats?[/b]

A: We are aware that the current stat system is highly flagged by our community, and plan to eventually make an overhaul of the entire system, making it easier to learn more about each item and how they are different from each other.  

[b]Q: Will the game be released for other languages than english?[/b]

A: Yes, we are working on bringing the game to as many languages as possible, we however wait with this initiative until our next major content update ready as localization can be an time consuming task, once it's in, it needs to be maintained every time we release a new update. 

[b]Q: Will Wartile come to Mac & Linux?[/b]

A: We dearly hope so, but during the Early Access we aim to keep our in-house testing time as low as possible, leaving more time to develop. The  systems support the more testing we have to do, for each small patch or content update. This is also the case regarding supporting VR, it would be awesome, but we are a small team. 

So we wait, and hope you guys can wait with us.


That was all for now, we know there are lots of other questions and we will try to pick them up as they come.

Until then have a nice weekend everyone. 

Best regards 

The Wartile Team

notes.title: Feedback Highlights from our Community
notes.notes:
We want to share with you some of the feedback we have received so far from our community through our different channels. We follow the Steam forum closely and pay attention to all the user reviews we get. We have also made it possible to provide us more detailed feedback through a Google form questionnaire, or just by rating us when leaving the game.  

To get a sense if we are on the right track, we ask our community to evaluate their experience and here are some of the results. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12134150/cb1e185fb67b1912e00ffe604d6386b6081c37f0.jpg[/img]

And from the exit screen where its possible to rate the game between 1 to 5 stars we score 4.98 in overall. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12134150/5aa5e9622140a4c3c01a9bbe6d68d0fff594daae.jpg[/img]

Individual story rate a bit low 3.29, and art pretty high 4.19. 

We can’t help to notice the ongoing discussions, about if Wartile should be a turn based game.


[b]Our goal and vision with Wartile[/b] is and have always been to the make a strong table top inspired game that keeps the action going, if this means it’s more or less one genre than another, is not our main concern. 
We aim to create a unique, fun and exciting game experience that  everyone can enjoy, regardless of their favorite genre.

Another interesting topic, is if the game is to hard. We aim to find a balance that give most people a good challenge without blocking anyone from completing the first difficulty stage.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12134150/c5c8322f34fd46e1869087872acaf6199e8a7c17.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Yay... We are now in Early Access
notes.notes:
Hi fellow Wartile Warriors 

I hope you are ready to loot and plunder the spoils of the world, at least the world of Wartile. As a team we are extremely proud to have reached this huge milestone and are happy to be able to share it with all you guys.

 [img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12134150/c0f2638f4e020a10ba7fed6edaf1aeb3f7fc9f4c.jpg[/img]

Since our last update we have been focusing on getting as many new features into the game as possible, before the Early Access, while also focusing on stability and accessibility. We have not succeeded 100% in all areas, but we will be spending some energy in the upcoming weeks, to improve the accessibility and communication in the game.  

Lets take a look at some of the new features. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12134150/c83a420dece99259db9242adf40b9553aa60d982.jpg[/img]

[b]The Campaign board[/b]
We have made a big art overhaul on the Campaign board, granting each section (figurine customization, figurine collection, card deck and the new Tavern, its own little box, with a fitting background. It’s a great improvement but still far from done.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12134150/41eb3ad090a7e3107948fb1bf5a51fe996552615.png[/img]

[b]Unlock-able difficulty stages[/b]
Each battle board now unlock up two new difficulty levels. These difficulty levels should offer the player a steep change in difficulty and I most cases better stats and equipment is needed to complete the higher levels.  

[b]The Norse Tavern[/b]
In the tavern, you can now view all the unlocked figurines during your play and if you have the gold to pay them and the fame to impress them you can hire them to your collection of Vikings. Changes to the item setup in the customization section.

[b]Relics / Way points[/b]
The relics placed around the maps can now be used to save your progress on the map. If dying later on board, you can choose to load your progress from that way point instead of restarting the whole mission.

[b]Story Cards & Objectives[/b]
Most story parts have been changed and we will introduce the main objectives with the main theme "Spoils of the world". At a later stage, we plan to make unique story strings (objectives) that will lead you through different battle boards, in a effort to complete it. 

Also to mention some other updates.

 [list]
     [*]New viking skins for the new tribes that will be introduced shortly
     [*]The armory had a big art upgrade, and changes to its setup.
     [*]Added a new tactical Card, The Bear Trap.
     [*]Added new animations to the figurines
     [*]AI units can now also use special abilities.
     [*]Major optimization pass on the Lost Norse battle board
     [*]Introduced the Unique items, such as the Skull of Norse.
[/list]

And a great deal of other stuff...

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12134150/e46ba52b8f115a5ae74cbe2f71f4b781262b4388.jpg[/img]

We hope that you will enjoy all the new content at we hope you enjoy it.

Have a nice weekend everybody.

Best regards 

The Wartile Team

notes.title: Wartile Launches March 17th on Steam Early Access
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12134150/01276caf7f05c73316a14ec31e50801895b58f1c.jpg[/img]

It’s with great pleasure and excitement that we finally can announce Wartile Early Access launch date on Steam to March 17th. With 3 years of development the team are proud and happy, that we have come such a long way and now feel confident to launch Wartile on Early Access.

[b]Feedback from the community[/b] have been a huge help for us in locating and prioritize our tasks in the game design, but also in how to design features to come. We would like to share some of the feedback with you. In the 0.4.4 update many players felt frustrated by the combat mechanics and the cooldown system locking down figurines. With the 0.4.4.2 This was changed and navigation of the figurines during combat got much more fluent and the reception was very positive.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12134150/ae1987b283dd320a995c74cce9f24c38be7b5bc6.jpg[/img]

[b]On Difficulty[/b] we raised the bar significantly throughout all Battle Boards and that shows on the feedback. Still the majority welcomed the change as a step in the right direction, with a few who voiced their fear of it getting too hard to enjoy the story.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12134150/1eceed584624464e03a122f5756a6c4ce45002ee.jpg[/img]

Knowing that most of you guys love a real challenge and realizing that life as a Viking was no dance on roses, we are currently implementing difficulty levels on each battle board that will unlock when you have completed all objectives on the board. This new level contain more trained enemies and additional encounters, but will also offer you the chance to unlock some unique equipment. The new Board difficulty levels will not break it for those who are just looking for a great experience, but don't want to die trying.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12134150/15d82ac640034bd0d442895588862b213983cfdd.jpg[/img]

[b]From our latest Closed Alpha[/b] round we asked our players where they would like to see the next improvements.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12134150/7ba063dda91a4835f2f271905f5e3764551b1eaa.jpg[/img]

[b]For the next update[/b] we will introduce many new features to Wartile, as the pie chart above states, there is a desire for more playable content, deeper combat and customization. To highlight what we are working on here is a short summery, we will be going into details when we are just about the release the updates, as we work very iterative on each feature. Just now we are working on adding a [b]Shop[/b] where you will be able to spend all the loot you earn. The first thing you will be able to buy is figurine classes, that you can bring with you into battle. Second we are introducing [b]Enemy abilities[/b] adding more depth to the combat. Something that was highly requested by the Community. We have started adding [b]Board difficulty levels[/b] that can be unlocked by completing all objectives, something that greatly will increase the single player content with a challenging experience and new rewards. We are also bringing in new [b]Warrior and Spearman versions[/b] with their own abilities and different stats. We are also updating the whole [b]story[/b] in a effort to add more local lore and story to each battle board. We hope that these new features will be well received.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12134150/d4b4dbdbc86731df79065cba407ed837ac585189.gif[/img]

For the [b]next Steam update[/b] we will focus a bit on each Figurine Class and how combining their attributes and abilities in the battle matters.

Take care everyone and kind regards from

The Wartile Team

notes.title: Wartile update 0.4.4.2
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone 

We just released an update that hopefully will handle some of the issues flagged by our community during the last few days of Closed Alpha. 

[b]Battle Boards[/b] 
Changed level design on The Lost Norse battle board. The player can now choose the easy way, or the hard way. The hard way being completing the secondary objective. 

Coastline Battle board some of the encounters have been changed to make it a bit easier, new challenge objective will be introduced later for those who like a real challenge. 

[b]AI[/b] 
The enemy units will jump less around, enabling tactical positioning. 

[b]Game play[/b] 
Simplified Cool-down system that no longer re-trigger on enemy attacks

[b]Bug fixes:[/b] 

fixed a bug that made it impossible to pick up figurine during an enemy attack.


Our goal with these updates is to improve the overall feel of tactical overview and improve the navigation and movement of figurines. 

Many are really happy with the hard difficulty, we are trying to setup the battle boards in a way where a hard challenge is something the player choose by completing the secondary objectives in the level.

[*] Second map could be won even though you lost all units
[*] Some text has been rewritten to be more clear
[/list]

notes.title: Wartile Update 0.4.4
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12134150/e05ad40232299c51b46d3085159ea069c4d37fc9.jpg[/img]

Hi everyone 

We have today released another big update to Wartile with lots of new content and many smaller tweaks all around.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12134150/e43ba8351784bb23276ee3ed5acd78b02b96ed2a.gif[/img]

Our main focus with this update is the multiplayer game mode, where you can challenge your friends to a one Vs one showdown or just show someone else who is the Alpha Viking. With Quick Match you will be matched up with anyone, also looking for a match (no matchmaking) or you can invite a Steam friend to a dual.

[b]The Multiplayer game rules are simple[/b] 
[olist]
[*]  Place a figurine on the relics that are dropping down from the sky
[*]   Don't move or loose you figurine while the relic converts / or try to kill the enemy standing on a relic before it convert.
[*]  When a relic is taken you score a point,
[*]  First team to score 3 points wins the match.
[*]  If you win, it means you are awesome.
[/olist]

[b]We have suggested some peak hours where everyone invited to the Closed Alpha can try the multiplayer mode.[/b]  

[b]Today Friday US[/b] 
5pm-6pm PST / 8pm-9pm EST

[b]Today Friday Europe[/b] 
9pm-10pm CET 

[b]Saturday & Sunday US & Europe[/b] 
4pm-5pm PST / 2pm-3pm EST / 10pm-11pm CET

You can also use the discussion tread to suggest good times to find out who is worthy of the favor from the Gods of the North. 

[b] Bold text [/b] 
[b]Patch Notes 0.4.4[/b] 

[b]Story:[/b] 
Few story parts have been update, but everything is still very much (Work in Progress)

[b]UI:[/b] 
A big update to all UI elements but most is still (Work in progress) 

[b]Balance:[/b] 
Increased the difficulty level by changing encounters on the battle boards.

The game might have become much harder, we will let you evaluate :D

[b]Multiplayer:[/b] 
Quick match for Multiplayer search (no matchmaking yet)
Friendly invites for multiplayer (invite your steam friends)
Changes to the Game play mode at Helgafjell 
New score system for multiplayer

[b]Battle Boards:[/b] 
Art update on The Swamp Battle Board
Art update on Helgafjell Battle Board
Added cave systems to the Hillside Battle Board
Changes to the

[b]Figurines:[/b] 
Changes to the stats of the units
Changes to the stats of Armor and Equipment.

[b]AI:[/b] 
Archers and spearmen will now try to avoid closed combat by keeping distance. 

[b]Equipment:[/b]  

Changes to the stats of Armor and Equipment.
Changed the rate of when equipment gets unlocked.

We hope that you will enjoy the updates and please use the feedback option in the game menu or here at the community hub to tell us what you think, 

You are also welcome to share your game experience public and show any game footage of your likings. 

Enjoy everyone 

Kind regards 

The Wartile development team.

notes.title: Happy Holiday and a Great New Year
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12134150/173e530bc8077483a54789ff1347e5e4f8642a79.jpg[/img]

Hi everyone, with 2016 almost behind us, it’s safe to say that this year have been a crazy ride with ups and downs, many unforeseen challenges, but also opportunities and artistic satisfaction. As the small indie studio we are, we had to survive on a very tight budget for a long time while keep pushing our boundaries in creating a game that stands out from the crowd, and plays well in your hands.

But we will enter 2017 on a high note, with you, the awesome community who keep motivate us and remind us why we love doing what we do.

We also enter the new year with enough funding to scale up production, thanks to funding from Zaxis ApS and The Danish Game Scheme. Furthermore it wont be long before we can announce Wartile's Early Access release date for those of you. who like to join us on a early adventure into a world of Miniatures.
 
               
[b]From the whole Wartile team we wish you all 
Happy Holidays and a great New Year.[/b]

notes.title: Wartile November News is out !
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12134150/a71d3df4858ca481faf820e46ba57aa7e9d3d1e6.jpg[/img]

[b]Hi Everyone and welcome to our[url=http://eepurl.com/ciCuZf] November Newsletter.[/url] [/b]

Everyday that passes, Wartile grows in content, features, polish and community. Seeing the growing interest in this project is a tremendous motivation for keep going, improving adding and optimizing everything we have built up so far and we can’t wait to share it all with you. We still have a lot of work to do on Wartile, but we think its almost time to share the game with those of you who want to be an active part of its development. 

First a big thanks to all of you of you who have been part of the Closed Alpha and provided us with detailed feedback and exit ratings. It helps us to better understand your game experience and prioritize our attention on features that matters to you.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12134150/7f67bb08e9b29a067fbb8bddca14b2b0244fa457.gif[/img]

With the next major update, we focus on the multiplayer experience, introducing a better quick match system and friend invites. So, if you want to give your friends an honest beating make sure they
sign up to the Closed Alpha and make sure to tell us about your (hopefully) winning experience afterwards.

If you want to be part of the last round in the Closed Alpha, then head to our  [url=http://www.wartile.com/#Newsletter] Homepage [/url]  and sign up to the Newsletter and mark the Closed alpha box. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12134150/2912e676d50e485dd992a976f51a349f0bd6d2ea.jpg[/img]

Since our last newsletter we have created a lot of new content and tweaked many features. Here is just to mention a few.

[list]
[*]Two new Battle boards set in an isolated dystrophic swamp
[*]Figurines can now level up, unlocking stats and new ability cards
[*]Deeper caves have been added to the Hillside Battle board
[*]Changes to all encounters on all Battle boards to increase difficulty
[*]Possible to navigate with keyboard
[*]Added new godly and tactical cards
[*]New figurine ability cards
[/list] 

[b]Please notice that most updates wont go live before our next update in a weeks time![/b]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12134150/7dfdebb15bac9c9c794ee0ea2f6be0e01171cd74.gif[/img]

We are also happy to announce that we have received founding from Zaxis ApS. This allow us to further develop and polish Wartile before going early access on Steam. Zaxis ApS is also behind Zaxis games who are producing Fimbul The Jotun Child, another really cool Viking game. 

This was all for now, we are looking forward to bring you more news about our next big update in a weeks time, until then .. have fun everyone and we hope to see you in-game.

notes.title: Update to the overall mood, feel and flow
notes.notes:
[b]Patch Notes 0.4.3[/b]

With today’s patch we have been focusing on improving the overall feel, mood and flow of the content already available. We believe it’s a huge improvement and hope that this will set the standard for our continuous work forward. 

[b]Story:[/b]
[list]
[*]Story parts have been updated, it’s still (work in progress) and the hillside and coastline have not been updated yet. 
[*]Small changes to the objective Cards in the two first battle boards.
[/list] 
[b]AI:[/b]
[list]
[*]Small fix making them react faster
[/list] 
[b]Multiplayer:[/b]
[*]When a player starts a multiplayer session, other players in the campaign menu will be asked to join. 
[/list] 
[b]UI:[/b]
[list]
[*]We implemented a new hint system in order to help players understand the game rules. 
[*]Pause game when looking at Quest Cards
[*]Removed mouse input when in fly by 
[*]In unit management changes in stats shows when hovering the mouse over them.
[*]Removed objective overlays when objectives are completed.
[*]Removed the news section from front screen, can now only be viewed from the options menu.
[/list] 
[b]Effects:[/b]
[list]
[*]New explosion effect added on death (Work in progress)
[*]Different effect on unlocking equipment still (work in progress) 
[*]New effect when unlocking a new battle board in the campaign menu
[/list]  
[b]Sound & music:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added environment sounds to the Tears of Eir Battle board
[*]Implemented transitions in music between exploring and combat states
[*]Added sounds to the goat
[*]Added sounds to the Card Deck 
[*]Added sounds to the ability card customization scene
[*]Sounds on teleport in and out of caves.
[/list] 
[b]Controls:[/b]
[list]
[*]Possible to “go back” with RMB in the campaign menu 
[/list] 
[b]Characters:[/b] 
[list]
[*]Models of the Lost Nose have been implemented (work in progress)
[/list]  
[b]Level design:[/b] 
[list]
[*]Small change to enemy spawn in the cave of the first battle board
[*]Action pause when going to the level complete screen
[*]Added small green frogs to The Tears of Eir battle board
[*]Added exit mark on the Tears of Eir when collection the needed 
information.
[*]Implemented quest cards used as objectives and story threads
[/list] 
[b]Art:[/b]
[list]
[*]Changed art on most cards still (work in progress)
[*]Changed art in the Campaign board still (work in progress) 
[/list]

notes.title: The Helgafjell Battle Board
notes.notes:
Yesterday we updated the Closed alpha build with the Helgafjell battle board, introducing the domination multiplayer battle mode where players need to control specific areas on the map in order to win the match. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12134150/66f14f2d72f1ae992adab8257fb41b5ecd21dc33.jpg[/img]

Helgafjell is a one vs one battle arena with a quick match system meaning that it will match anyone starting a session at the same time. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12134150/8a5a2205e874eca5a39cdf9cc63eaaa1c3103a99.jpg[/img]
  
You need to complete all four battle boards in order to unlock the multiplayer battle board and please be aware that it will most likely take some time before finding a match since there are only a limited number of closed alpha players.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12134150/7f67bb08e9b29a067fbb8bddca14b2b0244fa457.gif[/img]

We hope that you will enjoy the multiplayer if you manage to find someone to play with and remember to give us feedback on what you think, so that we can make it an even better experience. 

Kind regards 

The Wartile Team

notes.title: Progression Update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone

We hope that those of you who are playing the Closed Alpha are enjoying the game so far. We have just updated the Steam build with a bunch of new features mostly connected to the progression system, expanding the possibility to customize your figurines.

As you play through the Battle Boards your figurines will gain experience enabling them to increase in battle ranks where they unlock new ability cards and earn stat points, that can be assigned from the customization scene.

[b]The new ability cards include:[/b] 
[list]
[*]Shield Bash - [i]This will stun your enemy a few seconds[/i] 
[*]Shield Push - [i]Push the enemy a tile back[/i] 
[*]Roar - [i]Intimidate the enemy from attacking[/i] 
[*]Kick to the Groin - [i]Movement slow, decrease in attack & defense skill[/i] 
[/list] 

[b]New Godly & Tactical cards include:[/b] 
[list]
[*]Speed of Sleipnir - [i] Shortly Increase your movements speed[/i]
[*]Damage Trap - [i]An invisible trap that damage the enemy[/i]
[*]Snare Trap - [i]An invisible trap that immobilize the enemy[/i]
[/list] 
[b] UI [/b] 
[list]
[*]Possible to close the menu by pressing ESC
[/list] 
[b]Navigation[/b] 
[list]
[*]Moving figurines are less likely to land on incorrect tile
[*]Figurines will now face the direction they are moved
[/list] 
[b]Art[/b] 
[list]
[*]Small improvements on Objective cards
[/list] 
[b]Bug fix[/b]
[list] 
[*]Removed tiles wrongly placed in walls
[*]Crash bug occurring when moving into a cave 
[/list] 

On a end note, we would encourage everyone to give the game another try and tell us what you think about the new features. 

We would also like to thanks everyone who already have given us a lot of valuable feedback.

Kind regards 

Wartile development team

notes.title: New Gameplay Mechanic!
notes.notes:
We have been listening to the feedback from all of our backers on this Kickstarter campaign, as well as from those who have tried the pre-alpha build on Steam and one of the strongest sentiments among everyone is the desire to sometimes be able to slow down the action in WARTILE. 

Well, we've updated the Steam Pre-Alpha build with a new feature that allows you to slow down everything for 5 seconds, thus allowing you to quickly move your figurines or play your Ability Cards during that window of opportunity.

This new feature is activated by pressing the SPACEBAR, and once the 5 seconds have passed everything will return to normal phase, and the Slow Time feature will be on cooldown before it can be used again. During our internal testing, we saw how this new feature adds a whole new tactical element to the game and gives the player a second chance to react in very tight situations if used correctly. 

This is the first step in our ongoing effort to make WARTILE the best game it can be, and we'll continue to improve gameplay and add new content to the game after the Kickstarter is over. But in order for us to do this, we need to know what you think about the improvements and upgrades introduced by our updates, so please take a couple of minutes of your time to use the feedback form on the updated pre-alpha build to let us know what you think! 

And no, the introduction of this Slow Time feature does not mean that WARTILE will become a turn-based game, but we have for some time been playing with the idea to add some kind of pause or slowdown elements to avoid too much stress and micromanaging for players. For now, the timed cooldown is disabled in multiplayer games as we need to do more testing to see if it becomes a viable tactic for MP battles.
